snippet.title: Aksun - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the cursed Seal and unleash devastating combos in Aksun — a fast-paced roguelite inspired by Korean shamanism. Battle twisted spirits, master sacred weapons, and grow stronger through relic-powered evolution.

Every run is brutal. Every hit, a choice. Will you descend deeper?
⚔️ Dynamic Combat: Strike fast, dodge faster. Enemies won’t wait.
🌀 Weapon Synergy: Each weapon brings 3 unique skills — powered by divine forces.
🔥 Relic System: Fuse with spiritual artifacts to unlock new combat styles every run.
☠️ No Mercy: This is a place of death and rebirth — and not everyone returns.

Are you ready to master the Seal? Play the free demo now on Steam!

Steam ▶ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3129360/Aksun/
X.com ▶ https://x.com/waywaystudio
Discord ▶ https://discord.com/invite/ZcAeRzdbUg
